Job Description Inviting applications for the role of Principal Consultant, QA Lead- Salesforce Owns the quality assurance strategy and overall testing governance for assigned programs. Product Manager Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact? At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges. If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment. Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises. Get to know us at genpact.com and on Linked In, You Tube, X, and Facebook. Job Description The Product Analyst will play a vital role in our product delivery model supporting the ongoing evolution of our procurement analytics and orchestration capabilities. The scope of commercial analytics and orchestration includes, but is not limited to, value tracking/capture, spend analytics, orchestration, and our data solutions. Additionally, this role is expected to excel in partnering with business and digital stakeholders to identify innovative solutions that align with clients vision and drive value for our businesses.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Analyze and model current-state business processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. · Conduct detailed analysis of business requests to understand scope, feasibility, and impact on existing systems and processes. · Translate business problems into clear solution recommendations and develop detailed user stories, with technical details and acceptance criteria to ensure clear, testable, and aligned with business objectives are met. · Lead requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders to elicit, define, and document functional and non-functional requirements. · Develop and maintain detailed documentation, including business requirements documents (BRDs), user stories, use cases, and process flow diagrams. · Support Product Owner in sprint planning, grooming, and review ceremonies, acting as the primary point of contact for the development team to clarify business requirements and answer questions throughout the delivery lifecycle. · Support development of product visions, roadmaps, and business cases to inform investment decisions and strategic direction. · Serve as a secondary point of contact for stakeholder inquiries, helping to manage expectations and communicate backlog priorities when the Product Owner is unavailable. · Act as the Digital Technology (DT) representative on initiatives requiring expertise in procurement analytics, orchestration, and other digital procurement solutions. · Stay ahead of market trends and leverage emerging digital technologies within the supplier management capability to maintain a competitive advantage. · Support workshops to map current and future product value streams, identifying bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement, and translate insights into actionable plans. · Communicate effectively with stakeholders, building and maintaining strong relationships across the client’s ecosystem. · Communicate, educate, and raise awareness of product lines and roadmaps across the organization. Education & Professional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in IT or relevant field Experience working as a business analyst in a Technology organization Knowledge / Experience Relevant industry experience Strong knowledge and ability in the Data Analytics and Orchestration capabilities. Experience contributing to product roadmaps and ensuring alignment with business objectives. Proven ability to support or lead user feedback workshops and incorporate insights into product development Experience working in a technical environment with a broad, cross functional team supporting the progression of the product vision, defining product requirements and coordinating resources from multi-disciplinary teams Experience presenting technical concepts to business stakeholders Experience or foundational knowledge in data analysis and a track record of making data-driven decisions Demonstrated experience in conducting user research, defining user personas, and translating user needs into actionable product features Excellent communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills. Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment, especially with virtual geographically diverse teams Ability to produce accurate work under pressure with frequent deadlines Creative and resourceful approach to solutioning business challenges and an ability to deliver creative value-added solutions through self-initiative and ownership. Job Description Job Overview: Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, the SAP Security Build Leads will be responsible for SAP security technical delivery on the Digital Core transformation releases and deployments, beginning with release 0.6 and release 1.0. This Security Build Lead will deliver SAP security work including system build, security role build, testing, and deployment activities in SAP S/4HANA and other SAP edge systems. This position will support the program throughout full release lifecycles: initial SAP system security configuration and integration activities, security role design and build, security testing, cutover, and go-live activities. Working closely with Digital Technology and business stakeholders, the Security Build Lead will define access requirements, build functional / team-based access groupings, facilitate security role / permission testing, and support user access management. The Lead will also be responsible for ensuring that security outputs are consistent with the Shared Template, clean core, and other principles and standards of the Digital Core program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• SAP security project experience, including on large-scale S/4HANA transformation programs • Technical experience in the areas of SAP application security, IT controls, role-based access control (RBAC) strategies, segregation of duties, and SAP user access management processes (user provisioning, user access reviews, user terminations, single sign-on) • Proficient in security design, configuration, and deployment activities in SAP technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori, SAP GRC, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), and Central Finance. • Ability to learn new technologies (e.g., BTP applications) and apply RBAC concepts into the design, build, and deployment of these solutions to achieve efficiency and compliance • Experience in implementing process improvements, technical accelerators, and efficiency tools to deliver work with higher quality and cost effectiveness • Strong written and verbal communication skills; must be able to discuss and present security topics tailored to technical and business users • Flexible work hours to provide adequate overlap and coverage with a portion of US business hours • Technical SAP security delivery in the SAP S/4HANA and edge systems in scope of the Digital Core program • Perform technical security activities involved in setting up new SAP systems • Assist in the technical design of security roles (non-production project team roles and production business and technical user roles) • Lead security role build, testing, technical cutover and go-live activities for specific systems and/or functional process areas • Assist the SAP Security Senior Build Leads with planning and incorporating security tasks into timelines, plans, and program status reports • Document technical security design and configuration, and access procedures • Participate in service introduction activities to facilitate knowledge transfer of security concepts and procedures to the SAP Security AMS support team • Ensure security solutions are implemented consistently and aligned with centrally defined standards and requirements tasks for the new S/4HANA model • Collaborate with SAP and external consulting partners Qualifications Bachelors

Job Description End-to-End Process Oversight Manage the entire Invoice to Cash process, including billing, credit control, collections, dispute management, and cash application. Ensure compliance with internal controls, corporate policies, and regulatory requirements. Deliver services in line with defined SLAs, KPIs, and operational standards.
2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead and manage a team of I2C specialists (onshore/offshore) across different sub-processes. Drive performance management, training, development, and employee engagement. Allocate resources effectively to handle volume spikes and key account priorities.
3. Billing & Invoicing Oversee timely and accurate generation of customer invoices, ensuring adherence to contract terms and tax rules. Ensure electronic or manual billing processes function correctly, especially in integrated ERP or billing platforms.
4. Credit Management Ensure customer credit limits and risk profiles are properly assessed and reviewed periodically. Collaborate with finance and sales teams to approve or revise credit terms based on risk assessments.
5. Collections & Dispute Resolution Monitor collection activities and aging reports to minimize overdue receivables and reduce DSO. Drive timely follow-ups and escalation protocols for delayed payments. Oversee dispute resolution processes by coordinating with sales, operations, and legal teams.
6. Cash Application & Reconciliation Ensure incoming payments are accurately applied to customer accounts. Manage unallocated cash and unapplied credits efficiently. Coordinate with treasury and banking teams for timely reconciliations.
7. Process Improvement & Automation Identify areas for automation, digitization, or process optimization (e.g., dunning letters, RPA in cash apps). Implement lean initiatives or Six Sigma methodologies to improve accuracy and turnaround time. Ensure continuous improvement practices are adopted by the team.
8. Stakeholder & Customer Relationship Management Act as the key liaison between finance, customer service, and sales teams regarding I2C matters. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to improve payment behavior and dispute resolution. Participate in governance meetings and business reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
9. Compliance, Audit & Risk Management Ensure I2C processes comply with SOX, GAAP/IFRS, tax regulations, and corporate policies. Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and process walkthroughs. Mitigate financial and reputational risk by enforcing internal controls and escalation protocols.
10. Reporting & Performance Analytics Provide regular reports on AR aging, collection efficiency, DSO, bad debt provisioning, and cash flow impact. Use analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for performance improvement. Present dashboards and insights to leadership and finance teams. Qualifications Bachelors

jobDescription:
Tech Lead
- Application Development Microsoft N Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact? At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges. If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment. Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises. Get to know us at genpact.com and on Linked In, You Tube, X, and Facebook. Job Description Core Responsibilities Requirements Gathering and Analysis: Lead workshops and meetings with stakeholders to capture and document detailed business requirements, identify pain points, and conduct gap analyses between existing processes and D365 capabilities. Solution Design and Configuration: Design end-to-end functional solutions, leveraging out-of-the-box Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Power Platform features where possible. This includes configuring cases, knowledge management, queues, entitlements, SLAs, security models, and interactive dashboards. Contact Center Specialization: Implement and configure specialized contact center/Omnichannel features, such as unified routing, work streams, capacity profiles, data masking, and authentication settings to manage customer interactions across various channels (chat, email, etc.). Documentation and Training: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including functional design specifications, process flows, test scripts, and user manuals. Plan and deliver end-user training sessions and support change management activities to drive user adoption. Implementation and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams (developers, architects, integration specialists) to translate functional designs into technical solutions and support delivery throughout the project lifecycle (Agile/SCRUM). Develop and execute test plans (SIT and UAT) to ensure the solution meets business and functional requirements. Advisory and Support: Provide post-go-live support, troubleshoot issues, manage escalations, and recommend continuous improvements to optimize the system and enhance customer satisfaction. Advise clients on Microsoft best practices and emerging technologies like AI/ML and Virtual Agents.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience: Implementing and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions, with a strong focus on Customer Service or Contact Center solutions. Proven experience specifically with D365 Customer Service and contact center solutions is essential. Experience delivering multiple full-cycle implementation projects and managing client expectations. Technical Knowledge: Deep functional knowledge of the D365 Customer Service module, including case management, knowledge management, queues, routing, entitlements, and SLAs. Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse). Familiarity with data migration, system integration concepts (APIs, Azure services), and Dev Ops practices. Soft Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities. Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills to work with both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong self-starter with the ability to manage multiple tasks, work independently, and mentor junior team members. Certifications (Preferred): Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate (MB-230). Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200). Job Description Domain-Level Financial Strategy & Planning Develop and drive the financial planning strategy for the specific domain (e.g., business unit or function). Partner with business leaders to translate operational strategies into financial goals. Align domain-specific financial plans with the organization’s broader financial strategy.
2. Budgeting, Forecasting, and Variance Analysis Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes for the domain. Monitor actual financial performance vs. plan; investigate and explain variances. Identify risks and opportunities within the domain and recommend corrective actions.
3. Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary finance point of contact for domain leaders and their teams. Provide actionable financial insights to support decision-making. Influence and challenge stakeholders with data-driven recommendations.
4. Performance Management Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to the domain. Analyze trends and benchmarks to support performance improvement initiatives. Deliver reports and dashboards tailored to domain leadership.
5. Data & Analytics Oversight Ensure data integrity and consistency in all FP&A outputs for the domain. Leverage BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) to enhance reporting and insight generation. Collaborate with data and analytics teams to improve access to decision-support data.
6. Process Standardization and Improvement Implement and maintain standard FP&A processes within the domain. Identify areas for automation and efficiency improvements in planning/reporting workflows. Support deployment of FP&A tools and templates.
7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Coordinate with corporate finance, accounting, and other domain leads to ensure aligned planning cycles. Work closely with HR, IT, procurement, and other functions as needed to build accurate financial plans. Contribute to enterprise-wide FP&A projects and transformation efforts.
8. Governance and Compliance Ensure domain-level financial activities comply with corporate policies and financial regulations. Support audit processes and financial controls related to domain activities. 🔹 Skills & Qualifications Strong financial modeling, analytical, and business acumen. Deep understanding of the domain’s operational drivers (e.g., supply chain, sales, product). Experience with financial systems (SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, etc.). Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to influence senior leaders using data and insights. Qualifications Bachelors

Job Description Domain-Level Financial Strategy & Planning Develop and drive the financial planning strategy for the specific domain (e.g., business unit or function). 2. Budgeting, Forecasting, and Variance Analysis Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes for the domain. Monitor actual financial performance vs. plan; investigate and explain variances. Identify risks and opportunities within the domain and recommend corrective actions.

6. Process Standardization and Improvement Implement and maintain standard FP&A processes within the domain. Identify areas for automation and efficiency improvements in planning/reporting workflows. Support deployment of FP&A tools and templates.
7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Coordinate with corporate finance, accounting, and other domain leads to ensure aligned planning cycles. Work closely with HR, IT, procurement, and other functions as needed to build accurate financial plans. Contribute to enterprise-wide FP&A projects and transformation efforts.

Support audit processes and financial controls related to domain activities. 🔹 Skills & Qualifications Strong financial modeling, analytical, and business acumen. Deep understanding of the domain’s operational drivers (e.g., supply chain, sales, product). Experience with financial systems (SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, etc.). Job Description Job Overview: Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, the SAP Security Build Leads will be responsible for SAP security technical delivery on the Digital Core transformation releases and deployments, beginning with release 0.6 and release 1.0. This Security Build Lead will deliver SAP security work including system build, security role build, testing, and deployment activities in SAP S/4HANA and other SAP edge systems. This position will support the program throughout full release lifecycles: initial SAP system security configuration and integration activities, security role design and build, security testing, cutover, and go-live activities. Working closely with Digital Technology and business stakeholders, the Security Build Lead will define access requirements, build functional / team-based access groupings, facilitate security role / permission testing, and support user access management. The Lead will also be responsible for ensuring that security outputs are consistent with the Shared Template, clean core, and other principles and standards of the Digital Core program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• SAP security project experience, including on large-scale S/4HANA transformation programs • Technical experience in the areas of SAP application security, IT controls, role-based access control (RBAC) strategies, segregation of duties, and SAP user access management processes (user provisioning, user access reviews, user terminations, single sign-on) • Proficient in security design, configuration, and deployment activities in SAP technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori, SAP GRC, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), and Central Finance. • Ability to learn new technologies (e.g., BTP applications) and apply RBAC concepts into the design, build, and deployment of these solutions to achieve efficiency and compliance • Experience in implementing process improvements, technical accelerators, and efficiency tools to deliver work with higher quality and cost effectiveness • Strong written and verbal communication skills; must be able to discuss and present security topics tailored to technical and business users • Flexible work hours to provide adequate overlap and coverage with a portion of US business hours • Technical SAP security delivery in the SAP S/4HANA and edge systems in scope of the Digital Core program • Perform technical security activities involved in setting up new SAP systems • Assist in the technical design of security roles (non-production project team roles and production business and technical user roles) • Lead security role build, testing, technical cutover and go-live activities for specific systems and/or functional process areas • Assist the SAP Security Senior Build Leads with planning and incorporating security tasks into timelines, plans, and program status reports • Document technical security design and configuration, and access procedures • Participate in service introduction activities to facilitate knowledge transfer of security concepts and procedures to the SAP Security AMS support team • Ensure security solutions are implemented consistently and aligned with centrally defined standards and requirements tasks for the new S/4HANA model • Collaborate with SAP and external consulting partners Qualifications Bachelors

Job Description Role Overview: The Delivery Leader of Accounts Payable leads the end-to-end AP operations, ensuring accurate and timely processing of invoices, compliance with internal controls and regulations, vendor relationship management, and strategic transformation of the AP function. This is a senior leadership role, typically overseeing large, global AP teams in a shared services or enterprise finance environment. Key Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Strategic Leadership Define and drive the strategic direction of the Accounts Payable function aligned with overall finance and organizational goals. Lead transformation initiatives such as automation, process reengineering, and digital payment adoption to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Develop KPIs and benchmarks to monitor the effectiveness of AP operations and ensure continuous improvement.
2. Operational Oversight Oversee daily AP operations, including invoice processing, payments, T&E reimbursements, and vendor reconciliations. Ensure compliance with company policies, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards (local and global). Monitor aging reports, accruals, and payment cycles to maintain accurate cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization.
3. Technology & Automation Champion implementation and optimization of AP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba). Evaluate and integrate automation solutions such as OCR, RPA (robotic process automation), and e-invoicing tools. Drive digitization efforts to reduce manual touchpoints and processing time.
4. Team Management & Leadership Lead and mentor large, geographically dispersed AP teams including managers and specialists. Foster a culture of accountability, customer service, and continuous learning. Manage recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and career development of team members.
5. Vendor Relationship Management Ensure timely and accurate payments to vendors while maintaining strong vendor relationships. Negotiate payment terms and resolve disputes or escalations efficiently. Oversee vendor onboarding and data maintenance processes.
6. Internal Controls & Compliance Implement and maintain strong internal controls to prevent fraud, duplicate payments, and policy violations. Collaborate with internal and external auditors during audits and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Ensure global AP processes adhere to tax and legal compliance (e.g., VAT, GST, 1099, withholding tax).
7. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the key point of contact for finance leadership, procurement, treasury, and business units. Partner with Procurement and FP&A to align on spend analysis, budgeting, and cost control. Report performance metrics and strategic updates to CFO or executive leadership.
8. Risk and Issue Management Proactively identify operational risks, bottlenecks, and control weaknesses. Develop mitigation plans and lead root cause analysis and resolution of issues. Qualifications Bachelors

Job Description Role Overview: The Delivery Leader of Accounts Payable leads the end-to-end AP operations, ensuring accurate and timely processing of invoices, compliance with internal controls and regulations, vendor relationship management, and strategic transformation of the AP function. This is a senior leadership role, typically overseeing large, global AP teams in a shared services or enterprise finance environment. Key Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Strategic Leadership Define and drive the strategic direction of the Accounts Payable function aligned with overall finance and organizational goals. Lead transformation initiatives such as automation, process reengineering, and digital payment adoption to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Develop KPIs and benchmarks to monitor the effectiveness of AP operations and ensure continuous improvement.
2. Operational Oversight Oversee daily AP operations, including invoice processing, payments, T&E reimbursements, and vendor reconciliations. Ensure compliance with company policies, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards (local and global). Monitor aging reports, accruals, and payment cycles to maintain accurate cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization.
3. Technology & Automation Champion implementation and optimization of AP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba). Evaluate and integrate automation solutions such as OCR, RPA (robotic process automation), and e-invoicing tools. Drive digitization efforts to reduce manual touchpoints and processing time.
4. Team Management & Leadership Lead and mentor large, geographically dispersed AP teams including managers and specialists. Foster a culture of accountability, customer service, and continuous learning. Manage recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and career development of team members.
5. Vendor Relationship Management Ensure timely and accurate payments to vendors while maintaining strong vendor relationships. Negotiate payment terms and resolve disputes or escalations efficiently. Oversee vendor onboarding and data maintenance processes.
6. Internal Controls & Compliance Implement and maintain strong internal controls to prevent fraud, duplicate payments, and policy violations. Collaborate with internal and external auditors during audits and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Ensure global AP processes adhere to tax and legal compliance (e.g., VAT, GST, 1099, withholding tax).
7. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the key point of contact for finance leadership, procurement, treasury, and business units. Partner with Procurement and FP&A to align on spend analysis, budgeting, and cost control. Report performance metrics and strategic updates to CFO or executive leadership.
8. Risk and Issue Management Proactively identify operational risks, bottlenecks, and control weaknesses. Develop mitigation plans and lead root cause analysis and resolution of issues. Qualifications Bachelors

Job Description • Build and implement a factory model to industrialize the Robotic Process Automation (RPA) across all LOBs to deliver the agreed scope and realize the required business benefits using an Agile RDLC model. • Design and program manage RPA project plan and its adherence. Must have experience in deploying RPA bots elsewhere with direct experience in deploying RPA bots. • Create Road Map for RPA deployment. • Deploy RPA bots to improve transaction efficiencies across an account to improve operational effectiveness and adhere to controllership. • Deploy QPA and LSS projects for mitigating process issues and improving Operational efficiencies identified across towers. • Conduct full lifecycle of deploying bots through project management from analysis to design, development, and handing over to support through effective coordination between various functions involved in the entire lifecycle. Must have project management experience elsewhere. • Work closely with the RPA Technical team and Operations teams to ensure technical solutions are designed to deploy the bots as a team. Must have an understanding of one or more market-leading RPA technologies • Contribute to the creation of roadmap with account global operating lead for driving RPA transformation and process improvement and conduct periodic reviews with internal and external stakeholders calling out risks and issues on time. • Support Operations to meet the business objective by application of robotics and analytics capabilities • Robotics platform knowledge and Experience in driving RPA implementation. Experience in one or more of the market leading RPA platforms is must from Automation Anywhere, Blueprism, Uipath, or MS- Power Automate • Understanding of Six Sigma, Lean and Continuous Improvement concepts. • Project Management skills –Strong Influencing skills and clarity of thought on effective project management is required. Good to have PMP, CSM certifications. • People Leadership: Ability to coach & mentor people. Ability to effectively influence & motivate others and Ability to work in diverse teams and with multiple stakeholders • Delivers oral and written communications that have clarity and impact. • Creates a team environment of accountability and commitment for reaching project goals. Must be able to work in dynamic and tight deadlines to meet the project schedule. • Experienced Process improvement and Automation expert with domain exposure in F&A, Baking and IT domains. • Experience as LDT resource leading large business Client: • Responsible for directing VSM and Process Mapping activities for identifying and developing automation ideas. • As MBB, Conducting Workshops for identifying Automation opportunities and creating VSM to extract information required to make QPA, RPA Automaton roadmap. • Educate and make Genpact internal and Client stakeholders aware of the RPA deployment methodology for increased participation and collaboration where required. • LSS- GB / BB certification Qualifications Bachelors

2. Team Management & Leadership Lead and manage a team of accountants or finance analysts (onshore/offshore). Oversee task allocation, productivity, and team development through regular coaching and performance reviews. Ensure team members are trained on accounting policies, systems, and processes.
3. Financial Reporting & Compliance Ensure accurate preparation of financial reports and statements for internal and external stakeholders. Oversee statutory reporting, regulatory submissions, and compliance with SOX or other audit requirements. Coordinate with external auditors and internal audit teams during financial and operational reviews.
4. General Ledger Oversight Manage GL integrity, including review and approval of journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications. Oversee month-end and year-end close activities to ensure timely financial consolidation. Maintain and monitor chart of accounts for accuracy and consistency across entities.
5. Intercompany & Fixed Assets Accounting Ensure accurate recording and reconciliation of intercompany transactions and balances. Oversee the lifecycle management of fixed assets – acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, and disposal.
6. Reconciliations & Controls Supervise the preparation and review of balance sheet account reconciliations. Ensure proper documentation and resolution of reconciling items. Monitor internal control effectiveness and ensure audit readiness.
7. Process Improvement & Transformation Identify and implement opportunities for process standardization, automation (e.g., Black Line, RPA), and efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to transformation programs. Maintain up-to-date documentation of R2R processes, SOPs, and workflows.
8. Stakeholder Management Act as the point of contact for finance leaders, controllers, and business units for R2R service delivery. Collaborate with other finance towers (P2P, O2C), tax, treasury, and IT to ensure end-to-end financial process alignment. Conduct regular governance meetings and service reviews with key stakeholders.
9. Performance Monitoring & Reporting Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as close cycle time, reconciliation accuracy, and reporting timeliness. Analyze trends, exceptions, and SLA performance to drive improvements. Present insights and dashboards to senior management.
10. Risk & Compliance Management Ensure compliance with corporate policies, SOX controls, and global accounting standards. Support risk assessments and implement corrective actions for identified gaps. Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for all financial activities. Qualifications Bachelors

Get to know us at genpact.com and on Linked In, You Tube, X, and Facebook. Job Description Tax Compliance Ensure timely and accurate filing of direct and indirect tax returns (e.g., income tax, VAT/GST, TDS, withholding tax). Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations, assess their impact, and update processes accordingly. Liaise with government and tax authorities for notices, assessments, and litigation matters.
2. Tax Planning & Advisory Advise the business on tax-efficient structures for operations, investments, and transactions. Evaluate the tax impact of business initiatives, contracts, and cross-border activities. Provide guidance on transfer pricing, intercompany transactions, and permanent establishment risks.
3. Tax Accounting & Reporting Ensure accurate tax provision and reporting in compliance with applicable accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, GAAP). Support month-end and year-end close processes, including deferred tax calculations and tax reconciliations. Prepare tax-related disclosures and schedules for financial statements and audits.
4. Transfer Pricing Ensure transfer pricing documentation is maintained and aligned with global tax policies. Coordinate with external advisors to support benchmarking and compliance with OECD and local regulations. Support local and global transfer pricing audits and risk assessments.
5. Audit & Risk Management Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations. Manage tax assessments, audits, litigation, and appeals in coordination with legal counsel and consultants. Identify tax risks and design controls to mitigate exposure.
6. Process Improvement & Automation Drive standardization and automation in tax processes using tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Vertex, Alteryx). Job Description Summary of This Role Investigates potential credit card fraud cases based on information received from the fraud detection system. Maintains accurate and complete documentation of all information necessary for the investigation. What Part Will You Play? Responds to account inquiries providing the merchants and cardholders of 1 or more assigned clients with standard and occasionally detailed responses to Service Level Agreement (SLA) defined alerts generated within the fraud detection queues. Get to know us at genpact.com and on Linked In, You Tube, X, and Facebook. Job Description Summary of This Role Responsible for research and resolution of customer charge backs. Requires detailed transaction research, analytical skills, and documentation of actions taken including phone calls to merchants, cardholders, and others as appropriate. Applies bank and card industry regulations and practices in resolving disputes. May also compile aggregate statistics on charge backs for use by the company in identifying patterns and improving overall customer service. What Part Will You Play? Researches, processes, and resolves chargeback/reversal requests for all dispute reason codes and all supported card brands by utilizing established processes in a multi-client/system environment and adhering to association regulations. Gathers and analyzes cardholder and/or merchant account transactions to determine if the disputed transactions are covered under federal regulations, organizes supporting information, and applies appropriate credit/debit adjustments to accounts based on the final result of arbitration. May communicate with clients via "written" correspondence, as required, in an effort to determine the appropriate disposition of a chargeback request. Maintains a comprehensive understanding of all supported card brands (i.e. Visa/Master Card/Discover/Amex) and federal regulations governing credit card chargebacks and reversals through training and online research of regulations while working in accordance with department processes and procedures. Frequently reviews federal and card brand regulations for changes, and reports potential impacts to internal processes and procedures to management team. May provide recommendations to minimize impacts to the organization. Conducts side-by-side training on these changes, as needed. Job Complexity
- Works on assignments requiring considerable initiative. Understands implications of work and makes recommendations for solutions. Supervision
- Proposes methods and procedures on new assignments. May be informal team leader. Skills / Knowledge

training, certification, and skill development initiatives for team members. · Analyze operational trends, investigation outcomes, fraud patterns, and workflow performance to identify opportunities for process optimization and risk mitigation. · Review escalated cases, operational exceptions, complex investigations, and high-risk scenarios, providing guidance and supervisory approvals where required. · Ensure adherence to established procedures, regulatory requirements, operational controls, client policies, and financial crime risk management standards. · Perform root cause analysis on quality defects, investigation errors, processing exceptions, compliance gaps, and operational challenges, implementing sustainable corrective actions. · Partner with Quality, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, and Support teams to address performance gaps and strengthen operational effectiveness. · Drive employee engagement, recognition, succession planning, and retention initiatives within the team. · Monitor workload distribution, queue management, case allocation, and capacity utilization to ensure optimal resource planning and timely completion of work. · Prepare and present performance reports, operational updates, fraud trends, risk insights, and action plans to leadership. · Support implementation of new processes, technologies, automation initiatives, analytical tools, and business transformation programs. · Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous learning, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Job Description Job Overview: Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, the SAP Security Build Leads will be responsible for SAP security technical delivery on the Digital Core transformation releases and deployments, beginning with release 0.6 and release 1.0. This Security Build Lead will deliver SAP security work including system build, security role build, testing, and deployment activities in SAP S/4HANA and other SAP edge systems. This position will support the program throughout full release lifecycles: initial SAP system security configuration and integration activities, security role design and build, security testing, cutover, and go-live activities. Working closely with Digital Technology and business stakeholders, the Security Build Lead will define access requirements, build functional / team-based access groupings, facilitate security role / permission testing, and support user access management. The Lead will also be responsible for ensuring that security outputs are consistent with the Shared Template, clean core, and other principles and standards of the Digital Core program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• SAP security project experience, including on large-scale S/4HANA transformation programs • Technical experience in the areas of SAP application security, IT controls, role-based access control (RBAC) strategies, segregation of duties, and SAP user access management processes (user provisioning, user access reviews, user terminations, single sign-on) • Proficient in security design, configuration, and deployment activities in SAP technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori, SAP GRC, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), and Central Finance. • Ability to learn new technologies (e.g., BTP applications) and apply RBAC concepts into the design, build, and deployment of these solutions to achieve efficiency and compliance • Experience in implementing process improvements, technical accelerators, and efficiency tools to deliver work with higher quality and cost effectiveness • Strong written and verbal communication skills; must be able to discuss and present security topics tailored to technical and business users • Flexible work hours to provide adequate overlap and coverage with a portion of US business hours • Technical SAP security delivery in the SAP S/4HANA and edge systems in scope of the Digital Core program • Perform technical security activities involved in setting up new SAP systems • Assist in the technical design of security roles (non-production project team roles and production business and technical user roles) • Lead security role build, testing, technical cutover and go-live activities for specific systems and/or functional process areas • Assist the SAP Security Senior Build Leads with planning and incorporating security tasks into timelines, plans, and program status reports • Document technical security design and configuration, and access procedures • Participate in service introduction activities to facilitate knowledge transfer of security concepts and procedures to the SAP Security AMS support team • Ensure security solutions are implemented consistently and aligned with centrally defined standards and requirements tasks for the new S/4HANA model Collaborate with SAP and external consulting partners Qualifications Bachelors

- Computer Science, Bachelors
- Information Technology, Masters
- Software Engineering Certifications SAP Certified Application Associate
- Business Intelligence with SAP Net Weaver 7.0
- SAPSAP, SAP Certified Development Associate
- ABAP with SAP Net Weaver 7.0
- Atos Atos Required Skills SAP ERP Central Component (SAP ECC), SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Overview, SAP Security Language English (Required) Language Proficiency

Job Description Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and manage enterprise-grade real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. Build, configure, and maintain Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium, SAP CDC, and other enterprise CDC connectors. Configure and manage Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention policies, and security for multiple source systems. Manage and maintain Confluent Schema Registry, including schema evolution, compatibility, and governance. Deploy, configure, and optimize Enterprise Bus consumers and producers to support data ingestion from 29 source systems. Design scalable event-driven integration patterns to enable reliable, low-latency data movement across enterprise applications. Monitor Kafka clusters and optimize performance, throughput, latency, and resource utilization. Implement fault-tolerant messaging, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues (DLQs), and disaster recovery strategies. Collaborate with Data Architects, Integration Architects, application teams, and business stakeholders to define messaging patterns and data contracts. Develop automation for deployment, monitoring, and operational support using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code where applicable. Troubleshoot production issues related to Kafka clusters, CDC pipelines, message delivery, and consumer performance. Required Skills & Experience Experience in Data Engineering with strong expertise in real-time streaming and messaging platforms. Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform in enterprise environments. Strong experience implementing CDC pipelines using Debezium, SAP CDC, or similar technologies. Expertise in Kafka topics, partitions, replication, consumer groups, producers, Kafka Connect, and Schema Registry. Experience configuring and managing enterprise messaging infrastructure supporting multiple source applications. Strong understanding of event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, and distributed systems. Experience with Kafka security, including SSL/TLS, SASL, ACLs, and authentication/authorization. Proficiency in Java and/or Python for developing Kafka producers, consumers, and integration services. Experience with REST APIs, JSON, Avro, Protobuf, and event serialization frameworks. Knowledge of Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Confluent Control Center and enterprise Kafka administration. Exposure to stream processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, or KSQLDB. Experience integrating ERP, CRM, and enterprise applications using CDC and messaging patterns. Familiarity with data lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Delta Lake. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Qualifications Bachelors

Director
- Data Engineering Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact? At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Get to know us at genpact.com and on Linked In, You Tube, X, and Facebook. Job Description The role (Material Master Data domain Lead) we are introducing is pivotal in this journey. She/he is the voice of IT within the Product Data Council and therefore senior facing/influencer up to Director level. She/he will not only represent IT in working & steering groups, but be responsible for bringing thought leadership, leading practice and delivering agreed IT components & solutions. This role is responsible for creating a single, consistent view of Material Master Data (Raws, Packaging, Finished Goods, etc.) across client through the full lifecycle by establishing enterprise data model & architecture, SAP MDG Template & Integration, Data Quality & Process reporting and retirement of subsequent legacy solutions. Key Responsibilities This role collaborates with the various x-functional domain owners, in-flight programs (e.g. Traceability and Digital Foundations), stewards & governance associated with the Product Domain to translate business process and standards into an E2E solution template, data model and architecture for global deployment. They will work closely with the Data Senior Architect, MDM Technology Expert and relevant Functional Capability roles. The ideal candidate will have experience designing & delivering enterprise scale MDM solutions on the SAP stack (MDG/IS/Data Services/HANA, etc.). MDM Template Leadership & Delivery · Deliver the blueprinting and functional design of MDM Template solutions, linked to Master Data domain strategies, agreed golden processes and standards. · Design & deliver capabilities that enable scalable and actionable Data Quality insight, and ensure tools enable efficient processes. · Actively contributes to the Data Strategy and Enterprise Architecture definitions, based on experience and industry trends insights. Works to evolve standards and best practice. · Works closely with the Information & Application Architecture Director to ensure the right mix of skills & talent in technical delivery across internal associates & third parties, and supports strategic organization definition for Data Management. · Coaches and mentors junior associates pursuing a technical/expert career path and in their day to day work · Serve as the technical lead and senior architect on proof of concept (POC) and follow-on activities relating to the broader initiative Digital Foundations, Material Delivery · Define clear roadmap that ensures our migration from the AS-IS state to the TO-BE state is carefully planned and delivered, avoiding disruption to existing operations. · Is responsible for all milestones and resource within their scope, reporting into the Data Program Senior Manager. · Plan, agree and deliver against timeframes within budget estimates, influencing & direct scope as appropriate. · Work in partnership with leads from technology vendors and third parties to verify, validate & evolve approaches, designs & quality of end state solutions. Advice on and direct the Core Capability and Segment Data Roadmaps · Work closely with peer Architects to evolve the Data roadmaps which will help with their information needs. · Actively manage the transition process and define the migration guidelines for the segments from their As-Is landscape to the To-Be strategic landscape with the aim of simplification and improved efficiency of information. · Drive innovation in the Data initiatives of the portfolio and develop a longer term view of where the industry is moving and opportunities · Partner with the Data Senior Architect to actively drive the simplification of the landscape in working with the Core Services technical architects and drive decommission plans for all non-strategic components of the Global Data Architecture. Co-Develop the Data integration Strategy
1. Drive innovation in Master Data Management (MDM) portfolio and develop a longer term view of where the technologies are moving to and how they can be of used
2. As the market is changing rapidly in terms of Data integration products, managing this complex and changing environment and define a strategic approach to acquiring, managing and maintaining business data integration
3. With DT Master data leads and Data champions, identify & highlight where business demand requires either a suitable solution change or business transformation.
4. Delivers updates to Segment Leadership teams, with accountability to progress, own actions & risks Job Specifications/Qualifications College Degree, preferably in a technical field Considerable experience of Master Data Management or Data Architecture (including relevant collaboration experience) spanning multiple domains in a complex multi-national corporate environment. Experience in designing and implementing MDM solutions on the SAP stack (MDG/DT/Data Services/HANA, etc.) Envision, model and optimize complex yet efficient business processes, data and workflows. Demonstrated Leadership skills, with independence and proven management experience within a matrix organization. Background in the BI, Information, Data, Analytics space Strong Business Acumen of the FMCG industry and the Product/Material area Experience with Solutions Architecture, Applications portfolio management Budget Management (Project based) Stakeholder Relationship Management of global leaders Key Mars Leadership Competencies (4-6) Managing Vision and Purpose Business Acumen Command skills / Decision Quality Innovation Management/ Strategic Agility Dealing with Ambiguity Creates Collaborative Relationships Strategy, Governance & Architecture Portfolio Management Challenger Profile Designs Effective solutions System Change Management Information Analysis and Insight Generation User centricity Stakeholder Relationship Management Qualifications Bachelors

Role Overview The Mule Soft developer ensures robust, secure, and scalable enterprise integrations by leveraging the full Mule Soft Anypoint Platform—covering design, development, API management, governance, deployment, operations, monitoring, and B2B capabilities. Minimum Qualifications · BE/B Tech/MCA/B.Sc · Excellent written and verbal communication skills Preferred Qualifications/ Skills Key Responsibilities Architectural Design & Strategy: Design and implement Mule Soft integration solutions, ensuring they align with enterprise architecture standards and business requirements. Define API-led connectivity strategies, including experience, process, and system APIs, using Mule Soft Anypoint Platform. Develop and enforce integration standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization. Create detailed architectural diagrams, technical specifications, and documentation for integration solutions. Lead the technical design and development of complex Mule Soft applications and integrations. Oversee the development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment of Mule Soft assets. Provide expert-level guidance and mentorship to development teams on Mule Soft technologies and integration patterns. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, performance, and security best practices. Manage and configure Mule Soft Anypoint Platform components, including Runtime Manager, API Manager, Exchange, and Design Center. Define and implement CI/CD pipelines for Mule Soft applications to ensure automated and efficient deployments. Monitor the performance and health of Mule Soft integrations, identifying and resolving issues proactively. Collaborate with infrastructure teams to ensure optimal environment setup, scaling, and high availability of Mule Soft runtimes. Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust integration solutions. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate with other architects (e.g., enterprise architects, solution architects) to ensure alignment across different technology domains. Participate in project planning, estimation, and risk assessment activities. Stay abreast of the latest Mule Soft features, industry trends, and emerging technologies in the integration space. Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and practices to enhance the integration landscape. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for integration processes, tools, and methodologies.
